newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Yield up on Bulgaria 3-mth T-bills, down on 6-mth.
newsitem.headline: Yield up on Bulgaria 3-mth T-bills, down on 6-mth.

text.p: Yield rose at Monday's auction of Bulgaria's Finance Ministry three-month discount T-bills but fell on the six-month maturity as both issues were heavily oversubscribed, Finance Ministry figures showed.

The three-month paper yielded 1.38 percent, up from 1.36 percent for the respective maturity auctioned a week ago and yield to maturity on the six-month discount issue fell to 3.50 percent from 4.87 percent at the June 30 auction.
The two issues auctioned on Monday were offered with no minimum acceptable prices set in advance.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
Par value 10 bln levs 20 bln levs
Bids received 18.278 bln levs 60.475 bln levs
Average price of bids 98.47 pct 96.16 pct
Bids approved 10 bln levs 20 bln levs
Average yield to maturity 1.38 pct 3.50 pct
